text:
5 patterns. 3 timeframes. No breakouts called on a wick.

Free Compression Scanner Grok bot:
1. Triangles, wedges, pennants, ranges
2. 2+ touches per line, volume contracting
3. WATCH, BREAKOUT, RETEST or FAILED
4. TPs from real swings only

https://t.co/OKsUI6qV16

Not advice. https://t.co/JqsYVYZmIY

Card for the free Compression Scanner Grok bot template. Four features: 5 patterns (triangles, wedges, pennants, tight ranges), real compression only with 2+ touches and contracting ATR and volume, labels WATCH, BREAKOUT, RETEST or FAILED on the last close, and a Daily then 4H then 15m scan with take-profits from confirmed swings. Scans and charts only. Not advice.
 Right side: an illustrative chart of candles narrowing inside a white triangle with shrinking volume, then one candle breaking out (marked BREAKOUT) on a volume spike.
